title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training
authors: M. Lewis, Y. Liu, N. Goyal, et al. (8 authors)
before: BERT was good at understanding and GPT at generating, with no clean way to get both.
problem: Generation tasks needed bidirectional encoding of the input and autoregressive decoding of the output.
breakthrough: Corrupt text in several ways and train an encoder-decoder to reconstruct it.
why: It became the default seq2seq workhorse, and it is the generator inside the original RAG.
next: Used directly by RAG; the denoising family continued through T5 variants.
